verdict.rationale: Viam documents that data queues locally during network outages and low-bandwidth conditions, syncs when connectivity returns, and handles restarts and storage constraints automatically (viam-docs-7). Its SDKs also reconnect automatically when the network drops (viam-docs-70), and models run inference locally on the machine (viam-docs-9). A community comment that Viam assumes robots have internet access is an early design read, not a concrete failure report, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that robot control logic keeps running while the cloud is unreachable, details on buffer limits and sync conflict handling, and independent hands-on corroboration of outage recovery.
